effect.bossesrise_delight.ember_appetite: Three melee hits trigger a 4-damage burst and 2 damage to nearby hostiles. 2s cooldown; stronger at higher tiers.
effect.bossesrise_delight.blaze_digest.d: Reduce fire damage by 60%; a fire hit can restore 1.5 health every 4s.
effect.bossesrise_delight.frost_shell.de: A 4-point frost shield shatters into chilling mist. Rebuild after 6s without damage.
effect.bossesrise_delight.frost_reprisal: Taking damage counters a nearby attacker for 3 frost damage and slows them. 4s cooldown.
effect.bossesrise_delight.sand_surge.des: Starting a sprint or boss roll arms your next melee hit for +3 damage for 2s. 4s cooldown.
effect.bossesrise_delight.venom_sac.desc: Melee hits apply corrosive venom for 4s: armor erosion and damage each second. 3s cooldown.
effect.bossesrise_delight.tidal_echo.des: Melee hits echo after 0.6s for 2-5 extra damage. 3s cooldown; higher tiers strengthen the echo.
effect.bossesrise_delight.abyss_gills.de: Restore air underwater; spend 80 air to absorb up to 35% of a hit (max 4). 5s guard cooldown.
effect.bossesrise_delight.soul_harvest.d: Hostile kills collect up to 3 war souls. Spend all 3 to survive one lethal hit at 1 health; this effect ends.
effect.bossesrise_delight.nether_resolve: Taking damage below 40% health opens a 3s counter window: next melee +4 damage and heal 2. 8s cooldown.
effect.bossesrise_delight.hunter_resonan: Hostile kills restore 2 health to you and allies within 6 blocks. 1s cooldown.
effect.bossesrise_delight.rimebound.desc: Chilling mist reduces movement speed by 18%.
effect.bossesrise_delight.corrosive_veno: Armor is reduced by 12%; culinary poison deals damage every second.
tooltip.bossesrise_delight.battle_meal: Battle meal - edible even at full hunger
tooltip.bossesrise_delight.nether_ember: Dropped by Helvar. Crush on a cutting board to make Soul Salt.
tooltip.bossesrise_delight.soul_salt: Soul seasoning for the Nether Knight cuisine.
message.bossesrise_delight.soul_saved: Three war souls protected you. Soul Harvest has ended.
